name: New Ulm Reboot 2024

venue.name: New Ulm Community Center

information:
*Rebooting*... Welcome to the first competition in Southwest, Minnesota!

The event list and schedule is different than the original competition. Please be sure to check out the schedule and events before registering!

|  |
| -------- |

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWxjIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d1f52348f9e8749067367295f2008944d5ecb8df/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
